description: Noise gate, 6HP, stereo — it attenuates whatever is quieter than the threshold

params.text: The level below which it cuts, in decibels. CV alongside
How completely the quiet part is cut. CV alongside
A softer or harder transition as the signal crosses the threshold

inputs.text: The left signal into the gate; it is summed with the right to drive the level detector, and the channels patched here set the module's polyphony
The right signal into the gate; it is summed with the left to drive the level detector
The level below which it cuts, in decibels. CV alongside
How completely the quiet part is cut. CV alongside

outputs.text: The left signal after gating, cut by the same amount as the right
The right signal after gating, cut by the same amount as the left

menu: Attack time — a slider setting how quickly the gate opens, up to 500ms; 150ms by default
Release time — a slider setting how quickly the gate closes, up to 2 seconds; 600ms by default
Threshold range — scales what the THRESH knob covers: 1x (-24dB to 6dB) or 2x (-48dB to 12dB)
